# Week Diabetes Analysis

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A note summarizing patterns or trends in diabetes-related tracked data (e.g. glucose, insulin) across a week.

## Scope note

Narrower than WeekAnalysis and WeekDiabetes - the analytical output specific to diabetes data, tied to the Diabetes AI Coach project.
